title: Public projects.
bodyText: Any project or activity of any county or agency of the State in a designated district shall be constructed, renovated, or improved in consultation with the authority.
bodyHtml: [§206E-13]  Public projects.  Any project or activity of any county or agency of the State in a designated district shall be constructed, renovated, or improved in consultation with the authority. [L 1976, c 153, pt of §1]
